[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/tests/stb_png_read_fuzzer.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":7,"var":"data,size","code":"stbi_info_from_memory(data, size, &x, &y, &channels)","note":"Attacker-controlled PNG bytes are first parsed as image metadata, establishing that the same input will later be decoded."},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__png_info_raw","line":5100,"var":"p","code":"stbi__parse_png_file(p, STBI__SCAN_header, 0)","note":"The header scan walks PNG chunks and records image properties without fully decoding pixels."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__parse_png_file","line":4887,"var":"color, z->depth, has_trans","code":"IHDR/tRNS chunk handling","note":"A 16-bit grayscale PNG with a tRNS chunk sets up transparency processing for a 16-bit output path."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__do_png","line":5057,"var":"p","code":"stbi__parse_png_file(p, STBI__SCAN_load, req_comp)","note":"The same crafted PNG is then fully loaded, reusing the parsed transparency metadata during decode."},{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__parse_png_file","line":5007,"var":"tc16","code":"stbi__compute_transparency16(z, tc16, s->img_out_n)","note":"When the decoder expands the 16-bit grayscale pixel data, it applies color-key transparency to the output buffer."},{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__compute_transparency16","line":4769,"var":"p[1]","code":"p[1] = (p[0] == tc[0] ? 0 : 65535);","note":"The sink reads and writes 16-bit pixel components in the output buffer; the crafted image drives this path and triggers the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value in the transparency computation."}]
JSON
